title: United protests against SIR held in Delhi and state capitals on Constitution Day

ai.summary: Protests against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list recheck held in Delhi and state capitals on Constitution Day, with police claiming the sites were not permitted venues.

facts.claim: Protests against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list recheck held in Delhi and state capitals on Constitution Day
facts.quote: United protests against SIR held in Delhi and state capitals on Constitution Day

facts.claim: police claimed the sites were not permitted venues
facts.quote: police said the site was not a permitted venue

ai.background_note: The Special Intensive Revision is the Election Commission's house-to-house recheck of India's voter lists, which voters must link themselves or a parent to the roll from their state's last such revision two decades ago.
